key: The boat is idling on the tainted water... It seems to be ready to go.
en: The boat is idling on the tainted water... It seems to be ready to go.
ja: 船が　汚れた水の上で　待機している……いつでも出せそうだ
コーラルワードへ　向かいますか?

key: CAIN: Victoria should be at that Academy place, yeah?
en: CAIN: Victoria should be at that Academy place, yeah?
ja: カイン: ヴィクトリアは　あのアカデミーってとこに　いるんだよねぇ?

key: I'll fill her in ASAP so we can keep moving!
en: I'll fill her in ASAP so we can keep moving!
ja: すぐに事情を伝えてくるよ　そしたら　先に進めるからさ!
目指すは　パイロス山だ!

key: ~ You turn to us, whenever you need us
en: ~ You turn to us, whenever you need us
ja: 〜 必要なときは　いつでも　わたしたちを頼って

key: We've got the power to protect us all ~
en: We've got the power to protect us all ~
ja: みんなを守る力が　ここにあるから 〜

key: ~ One thing is true: we're kind of magic,
en: ~ One thing is true: we're kind of magic,
ja: 〜 ひとつだけ本当のこと　わたしたちは　ちょっとした魔法

key: At the tip of your fingers, whenever you call ~
en: At the tip of your fingers, whenever you call ~
ja: 呼べばいつでも　指先に 〜

key: I love coming here. It's so nice to just get away from everything and lose yourself in the sand...
en: I love coming here. It's so nice to just get away from everything and lose yourself in the sand...
ja: ここに来るのが　好きなんだ。何もかも忘れて　砂に身をまかせるのは　最高だよ……

key: Like water over rocks, this loss will fall over me.
en: Like water over rocks, this loss will fall over me.
ja: 岩を流れる水のように　この喪失も　わたしを流れていく

key: Like the river-polished stone, I am more whole as a person for it.
en: Like the river-polished stone, I am more whole as a person for it.
ja: 川に磨かれた石のように　わたしは　より完全な人間になる
